title: Conditions to check for How the Recycle Bin Works

question.author: member_145
question.body: Could support clarify how the recycle bin works in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Recycle Bin and Deletion documentation says: Restoring an item returns it to its original location with its sharing settings intact. Items in the recycle bin do not count against your storage quota, but they remain visible to anyone who had access to the original item's folder. When you delete a file or folder in any CloudBox client, it moves to the recycle bin instead of being destroyed. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
